stockMovements.title: Stock movements
stockMovements.subtitle: Every issue, return, transfer and scrap has a document, a reason and a user
stockMovements.readOnly: Read-only access: you can see movements but not record them.
stockMovements.noRight: You don't have the right to issue or return stock. Ask Admin.
stockMovements.issueNote: Only released stock can be issued. The server takes the lot that expires first unless you choose one, and refuses anything that would go below zero.
stockMovements.confirmIssueEffect: Takes {{qty}} {{uom}} of {{item}} out of {{store}}. A posted movement is never edited; a mistake is put right with a return.
stockMovements.noIssues: Nothing is still out on an issue
stockMovements.returnNote: Anything that left the stores comes back into QC hold unless you choose stock.

err.qty: Enter a quantity above zero (up to 3 decimals).
err.ref: Give the batch, job or order number, or the cost centre.
err.issue: Choose the issue the material came from.

stockMovements.loadError: The movements could not be loaded. Try again.
stockMovements.emptyBody: Movements appear here as soon as stock is received, issued, moved or counted.
